danger.label: Danger
danger.hint: Errors, delete buttons and deny rules

highContrast.label: High contrast
highContrast.description: Pure black and white with strong borders, for low vision.

redGreen.label: Red-green safe
redGreen.description: For protanopia and deuteranopia: blue for success, orange for danger.

blueYellow.label: Blue-yellow safe
blueYellow.description: For tritanopia: teal for success, red for danger, pink for warnings.

appearance.customHint: Your own colours, starting from the theme above.
appearance.customColoursHint: Set eight colours; every other colour is worked out from them.
appearance.lowContrast: Text against the background has a contrast of {contrast}:1; at least 4.5:1 is recommended for reading comfortably.
appearance.advancedHint: Changes here apply on top of the theme above and stay when you switch themes.

accessibility.intro: For colour blindness, the Red-green safe and Blue-yellow safe themes recolour the interface. The options below help with the colours people choose for labels, priorities and roles.
accessibility.patternsHint: Each label gets its own stripe or dot pattern, so labels differ by more than colour.
accessibility.ranksHint: Shows each priority's rank, P1 being the most urgent, next to its name.
accessibility.filter: Colour filter for labels, priorities and roles
accessibility.filterHint: Shifts colours that are hard to tell apart into ones that are easier to see.

simpleView.intro: Hide what you do not use, on every board. This only changes what you see: the data stays, and everyone else still sees it. Servers that switched a feature off hide it for everyone.

sessions.intro: Devices and browsers signed in to your account. Signing one out ends it straight away, including any board it has open.
sessions.signOutFailed: Could not sign out that session

language.intro: Your language isn't here yet? Tell the developer which one you'd like. Translations are added as people ask for them.
